notes: Giving the supplied more to ἤ rather than marking it added follows rule 11 and rule 103's licensing test: ἤ is what licenses the comparative frame, and its English is incomplete without it.
χρείαν ἔχουσιν collapses into the single English verb need, so the pair is one unit under rule 73 with the source head on the noun the English realizes.
οὕτως takes even so whole, no answering καί standing (rules 82 and 100); μετανοίας is not a negative word, so rules 41 and 59 do not empty οὐ.
